scenario: ID Verification Decision → Client Notification + Discord Invite
trigger: POST from /api/onboarding/verification after admin approves or rejects
description: Fires after an admin approves or rejects a client's ID verification. On approval: Make.com sends the client their Discord OAuth invite link via email and/or SMS, updates GHL status, and posts a welcome message in the staff Discord. On rejection: sends a rejection email with reason and prompts the client to resubmit.

payload.name: string — client's full name
payload.reason: string | null — rejection reason (only present when status = 'rejected')
payload.discordChannelId: string | null — Discord channel ID for the client (if Discord onboarding was started)
payload.driveFolderUrl: string | null — URL to the client's Drive folder
payload.timestamp: string — ISO 8601 timestamp of the decision

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — check status field
Step 2 (approved): Send Discord invite email to client via Gmail
Step 2 (rejected): Send rejection email with reason and resubmission link
Step 3 (approved): Post staff Discord notification — client approved, Discord access granted
Step 4 (approved): Update GHL contact status to 'id_verified'
Step 4 (rejected): Update GHL contact status to 'id_rejected' with reason note
Step 5 (approved): Tag GHL contact with 'id-approved' tag for campaign enrollment
